metadata.title: Therapeutic massage in Portland
metadata.description: Licensed massage therapist offering Swedish, deep tissue, sports, and pregnancy massage. Private studio, easy online booking, same-week availability.

blocks.heading: Reset your body with calm, skilled hands
blocks.subtext: Laura is a licensed massage therapist focused on pain relief, stress recovery, and safe, nurturing care. Same studio every visit — clear plans, no rush.

items.title: Swedish & relaxation
items.description: Flowing strokes, gentle pressure, and breath-led pacing to lower stress hormones and improve sleep quality the same week.

items.title: Deep tissue & sports
items.description: Targeted work on neck, shoulders, low back, and legs — ideal after desk work, training blocks, or long travel days.

items.title: Pregnancy-safe massage
items.description: Side-lying positioning with bolsters, modified pressure, and focus on hips, ribs, and feet as your body changes.

items.title: Focused recovery sessions
items.description: 45- or 60-minute appointments built around one problem area plus quick full-body check-in so you leave moving easier.

items.title: Hot stone add-on
items.description: Warm basalt stones layered into the back and legs to soften tissue before deeper work — optional on 75+ minute bookings.

items.title: First-visit intake
items.description: Health history, goals, and pressure preferences captured up front so every session matches how you feel that day.

items.name: Kauta El Omari
items.quote: Increíble la experiencia , llevaba dos días con un dolor terrible de brazo y en una sola sesión me ha quitado el dolor. Una chica super agradable y encantadora.

items.name: Daniel Anaya
items.quote: Resultados visibles desde la primera sesión y trato inmejorable. Laura es una gran profesional y te hace sentir como en casa.

items.name: Raquel Campillo
items.quote: Fui recomendada, me habían hablado maravillas de Laura. Aparte del trato, que es fantástico, es una excelente profesional. Sin duda, volveré.

items.question: What should I wear?
items.answer: Undress to your comfort level; you stay draped the entire session. Only the area being worked is uncovered.

items.question: Do you offer couples or tandem massage?
items.answer: This is a one-table studio for individual appointments only. I can refer partner clinics if you need side-by-side rooms.

items.question: What is your cancellation policy?
items.answer: Please give at least 24 hours notice so the slot can go to someone on the waitlist. Late cancellations may be charged 50% of the service fee.

items.question: Do you accept HSA or FSA cards?
items.answer: Many clients use HSA/FSA when massage is prescribed for a diagnosed condition. Check with your plan administrator; I can provide a detailed receipt.
